notes.title: Celebrate the Lunar New Year - Year of the Pig with 75% off!
notes.notes:
In case it wasn't obvious, we love pigs, with them being a central part of the game so what better way to celebrate the Lunar New Year - Year of the Pig with  a MASSIVE 75% discount of the game!

For just $4.99 you can now hop into the wackiest social party VR game! Got it already? Gift it for your VR buddies and get them online too

notes.title: Steam Winter Sale now on!
notes.notes: Now that the [b]Steam Winter Sale[/b] has started, you can get [b]50% off[/b] the price of the game! Perfect timing for having lots of family and friends over during the holidays and introducing them to VR!

notes.title: v1.25 Patch Update : Fixes & New Features
notes.notes:
Greetings trialists!

I've pushed out a new build to the live servers (v1.25) that fixes a couple of issues some people were having and adds a new feature for shortys:

- New RU servers added for multiplayer lobbies
- New Mixed Reality support and fixes so you can green screen your gameplay
- New 'Minor Feature' update that adds a virtual box under the metagame table for short people to pull out and stand on to virtually boost their height


Enjoy!
~The Grand Sensei

notes.notes:
We're testing a new build that adds a new minor feature update!

If you patch to the beta channel, you'll find a box under the central metagame table that if you pull out and stand on, will boost your virtual height.

Great for kids playing!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Loco Dojo, 35% off!
notes.notes:
Loco Dojo is Now Available on Steam for HTC Vive and Oculus Rift and is 35% off!*

Enter the whimsical wooden world of Loco Dojo and step up to Grand Sensei ™s Table of Trials ™ to pit your silliest skills against (up to) three friends or strangers in this hilariously competitive cross-platform multiplayer social VR party game.

*Offer ends August 3 at 10AM Pacific Time
